notes.voucher_paymaster: Redeployed 2026-09-05T20:19:54Z after adding real batch versioning: register_voucher_batch now returns a version number instead of silently overwriting the sponsor's previous root, and validate_voucher takes that version so any batch a sponsor has ever registered stays redeemable, not just their latest. This is a breaking ABI change (validate_voucher gained a batch_version parameter), so CBDBUQMTLZMXSLHC7I3OJWH7CENHGTCYTUB6FUUOJSYNWSS5ED2T4JZS is stale and cannot be reused as-is. No voucher batch is registered yet on this new instance; register_voucher_batch must be called by a real sponsor before any voucher can be redeemed.
notes.gas_estimator_removed: The gas_estimator contract (formerly CB7LM3KHQS6W3EVYWYZDCH572OUP7YELJVF3UNHYAVXZNIGZO6DHT2O3, deployed 2026-09-03) was removed from this workspace on 2026-09-05, not just redeployed. Its stated goal — a real on-chain resource-usage measurement — turned out to be infeasible without either faking a formula (what it always did) or actually executing the target call as a side effect just to measure it, which is unsafe and defeats the purpose of an estimate. Real Soroban gas/resource estimation is an off-chain RPC preflight-simulation concern, and stellar-gasless-relayer's SorobanSimulator already does this for real via simulateTransaction before ever sponsoring a fee. The old address is left deployed on testnet (contracts can't be deleted from a ledger) but is no longer part of this workspace, referenced by any script, or presented as a working feature.
